title: Citations & Referencing
tagline: Master APA 7th, Harvard, IEEE, and Vancouver with zero guesswork.
outcomes: Differentiate between parenthetical and narrative in-text citation styles across single and multiple authors.
Format references correctly for journal articles, books, chapters, online reports, and datasets in APA 7th.
Understand the author-date rules of Harvard style and the numeric systems of IEEE and Vancouver.
Integrate Zotero with word processors to automate citation generation and resolve reference discrepancies.

modules.title: Module 1: Principles of Citation & In-Text Mechanics
modules.description: Master why we cite and the precise mechanics of parenthetical vs narrative citation.

lessons.title: Why We Cite and What Happens When We Don't
In-Text Citation Rules: Parenthetical vs Narrative
Handling Multiple Authors, Et Al., and Corporate Authors

modules.title: Module 2: APA 7th Reference List Dissection
modules.description: Dissect the four core components of any APA 7 reference: Author, Date, Title, and Source.

lessons.title: Citing Journal Articles, DOIs, and URLs
Citing Books, Edited Chapters, and Theses
Citing Online Reports, Government Data, and Web Pages

modules.title: Module 3: Alternative Styles: Harvard, IEEE & Vancouver
modules.description: Understand variations across faculties: author-date Harvard, bracketed numeric IEEE, and medical Vancouver.

modules.title: Module 4: Formatting, Zotero Integration & Final Check
modules.description: Audit references, link citations to the bibliography, and verify submission readiness.
